violations.description: POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of bean sprouts pork in glass 2 door upright and various ingredients in walk in cooler was noted not being properly dated for disposition.
CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted not properly labeled with the proper identifyer in the 2 door upright cooler and food ingredients in large stock pots in the walk in cooler.
STORAGE/HANDLING CLEAN EQUIP & UTENSILS (1 pts): Unwrapped utensils noted being offered in such a way that the lip or food portion must be touched to obtain the utensil.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of frozen and then thawed to alow for consumtion was noted not being properly dated for disposition.

SINGLE - USE/SINGLE - SERVICE ARTICLES (1 pts): Single service items articles noted made of unapproved materials. Observed food items stored in a sheet pan in the prep top coolers covered with a kitchen drawstring garbage bag. Kitchen garbage bags are not appropriate as a food storage method.
